outcome: Opioid prescribing patterns at postpartum hospital discharge
Amount of opioid morphine milligram equivalents prescribed
cohort: 12,326 women after delivery at a single, high-volume tertiary care center over a 1-year period
finding: Opioid prescriptions at postpartum hospital discharge were common, with a wide range of morphine milligram equivalents prescribed and no significant difference in prescribing patterns based on objective or subjective pain assessments.
mod_finding: Women received similar amounts of opioid prescriptions after vaginal and cesarean deliveries regardless of pain levels.
